{{Quote|The Chirq Council is experimenting with a new kind of mechanized guardian.|[[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Hurley Klakk|Klakk]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:DtMGitCCB">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Destroy the Mechanized Guardians in the Chirq Council Bunker|Corellia}}</ref>}}
The '''Chirq Council Mechanized Guardian''' was a type of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] that was used by the [[Chirq Council]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
{{Quote|My assignment is to hamper the production of those mechanized guardians. I figure the best way to do that is to destroy the ones they already have. Your part would be to enter the Chirq Council bunker and destroy any mechanized guardians you find.|Agent Klakk, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:DtMGitCCB" />}}
The Chirq Council Mechanized Guardians were developed and produced in the [[Second Elite Council Bunker]], near [[Doaba Guerfel/Legends|Doaba Guerfel]], after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="SWG:DtMGitCCB" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the [[Corellian Security Force]] started an investigation against the Chirq Council following the increase of [[Ryll/Legends|ryll]] traffic on Corellia.<ref name="SWG:TCCSC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|The Chirq Council: Seek Council|Corellia}}</ref> [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Vitala Baize]] infiltrated a CorSec agent in the Chirq Council and discovered the locations of their secret headquarters.<ref name="SWG:TCCMU">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other}}Legacy Quest: "The Chirq Council: Moving Up" on Corellia</ref> During the subsequent CorSec assault on the Second Elite Council Bunker,<ref name="SWG:TCCTEC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|The Chirq Council: The Elite Council|Corellia}}</ref> [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Hurley Klakk]] was tasked to hamper the production of the Chirq Council Mechanized Guardians. Klakk thought that the best way to achieve the objective was to destroy the droids already built. He thus hired an independent spacer who previously worked for the CorSec to help him in his mission. The spacer entered the Second Elite Council Bunker, fought the Mechanized Guardians and successfully destroyed them.<ref name="SWG:DtMGitCCB" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Chirq Council Mechanized Guardians appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:DtMGitCCB" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Chirq Council Mechanized Guardians were added to the game with the update named "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 1|Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives]]," published on [[June 8]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives, Publish Notes, June 8th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=DevDiscussion&message.id=48548|text="Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives", Publish Notes, June 8th}}</ref> They shared the same model with the [[CY-M Prototype]]s<ref name="SWG:ToOW">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Trials of Obi-Wan]]''</ref> and the [[ZH-28 guard]]s.<ref name="SWG:ORDMTD">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Old Republic Droid Modules: The Droideka|Naboo}}</ref>
